thread_title: S. leucophylla red lips white interior Covington Co, AL
breadcrumb: S. leucophylla red lips white interior Covington Co, AL

posts.body_html:
Here's a "new" clone of leucophylla that I got my eyes on, I don't know much about it just yet but will update this thread as more observations are made. So far, it looks pretty darn cool, so I think it's worthy of being propagated and distributed. This came from Hundreds of seedlings and sticks out from the rest because of that great color contrast.
